excerpts: Signing, if you lose your app’s signing key, you lose the ability to update your app. Important: If you want to use the same signing key across multiple stores, make sure to provide your own signing key when you configure Play App Signing , instead of having Google generate one for you. Figure 1 . Signing an app with Play App Signing Your keys are stored on the same infrastructure that Google uses to store its own keys, where they are protected by Google’s Key Management Service. You can learn more about Google’s technical infrastructure by reading the Google Cloud Security Whitepapers . When you use Play App Signing, if you lose your upload key, or if it is compromised, you can request an upload key reset in the Play Console.
